name: sensitivity_A_sky_v1
status: pre-declared sensitivity variant of Baseline A; never the headline
model_choice_note: PRIMARY specification = bounds only (no informative priors), the practice of the published fixed-optics inversion (snowlaps). The informative-prior variant is a pre-declared sensitivity run, never the headline.

forward.solver: BioSNICAR adding-doubling, pinned checkout fe74eeef (phase2/biosnicar_bridge.BioSNICARRunner), 480 bands of 10 nm

illumination.sza_rule: noon solar zenith from day-of-year at S6 latitude (phase2/empirical_data.solar_zenith_noon), the rule of phase4/h1_albedo
illumination.sky_note: S6 albedo is ALDN/ALUP with a cosine receptor under the actual sky (clear to cloudy); the primary spec assumes direct beam. The mixture is bounded by the two end-member skies; no per-plot cloud value is used.

log10_dust_ppb.unit: log10 ppb (ng/g); the S6 campaign mean is about 5.5

log10_bc_ppb.unit: log10 ppb; a proxy for ALL dark particles (BC, cryoconite organics), not black carbon specifically

diffuse_fraction.unit: fraction of downwelling irradiance that is diffuse; mixes direct-beam and fully-diffuse albedo linearly (approximation)

observation.operator: 10-nm box average of the 1-nm field spectrum onto the model band centres (operators.band_average)
quality_rules: a band is used only if at least half of its 1-nm samples are finite
albedo must lie in [-0.02, 1.02] inside the window (operators.check_albedo_bounds)

error_model.sigma_obs_basis: documented albedo accuracy +-0.01-0.02 (docs/data_manifest.md, not re-verified against the source paper)
error_model.sigma_total: RMS of held-out-window residuals of TRAINING days only (leave-one-day-out), never below sigma_obs
error_model.correlation: AR(1) inflation from the lag-1 autocorrelation of TRAINING-day residuals: kappa = sqrt((1+rho)/(1-rho)), clipped to [1, 6]

profile.interval: Delta chi2 <= 3.84 (1-d, 95 %), scaled by sigma_total and kappa

informative_priors.note: abundance prior from S6 2016 (independent year); radius prior from measured SSA

k_anisotropy.prior: Normal(0.898, 0.175), learned from the S6 development set (ARF)

transfer_check.counts_used: Table S4 rows dated 2021 with measured == True and a finite ice-algal count
transfer_check.labelled: reused data, NOT an untouched test

reference_reproduction.snowlaps_forward: snowlaps emulator re-implemented in NumPy from the shipped weights; per-spectrum MAE compared with the shipped results table
reference_reproduction.cook2020_published_retrievals: 29 S6 plots with algae_cells_inv_model_S2 in Spectra_Metadata.csv (reference only)
